name: Calendar
purpose: A grid of days for picking a date or a range. It supports single, multiple and range selection.

notFor.when: The person wants a date in a form field, with a calendar that opens from it.
The person knows the date and can type it.

basis.note: Behaviors come from the Notion UI SDK inventory (2026-11-21). The support tag on each one was checked against the source on the checked date. The library is not Radix. Rows for a read only mode, a refusal and a controller were not found in the source and are tagged supply.

anatomy.note: The picker. It takes mode, selected and onSelect.
The month and year, or two selects.
One day. It is 44 square in vois-calendar.

behaviors.text: One tab stop. Arrow Left and Right move a day, and Arrow Up and Down move a week.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker DayPicker.js lines 173 to 199: arrows move by day and week
behaviors.note: The tab stop is the selected day, then today, then the first day of the month.

behaviors.text: Page Up and Page Down move a month. Shift with them moves a year. Shift with the arrows moves a month or a year.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker DayPicker.js lines 173 to 199: PageUp and PageDown by month, with Shift by year

behaviors.text: Home and End go to the start and end of the week.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker DayPicker.js: Home and End go to start and end of week

behaviors.text: Escape cancels a range that is half chosen.
behaviors.note: DayPicker has no Escape handling. Keep the draft range in your own state and drop it on Escape.

behaviors.text: Choosing a day selects it. In single mode, choosing it again clears it unless the picker is required.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker: single mode deselects on a second press; required keeps it selected
behaviors.note: Set required when the field must have a date.

behaviors.text: In range mode, the days between the start and the hovered day are shown while the person picks.
behaviors.note: DayPicker draws no range preview. Track the hovered day and add a modifier.

behaviors.text: Multiple mode keeps the dates in order.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker: multiple selection is not sorted
behaviors.note: Sort them in onSelect if order matters.

behaviors.text: A selection can be refused, with a reason.
behaviors.note: There is no cancel or reason. Use the disabled matcher and your own onSelect check.

behaviors.text: The calendar can be read only.
behaviors.note: DayPicker has no read only mode. Disable the days and keep the labels readable.

behaviors.text: The visible month can be set by code, and a change is reported.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker: month, defaultMonth and onMonthChange props

behaviors.text: Previous and Next change the month. The year and month can come from native selects.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker: captionLayout dropdown uses native selects
behaviors.note: The default year range is 100 years back to the end of this year. Set startMonth and endMonth to narrow it.

behaviors.text: Days outside the allowed range cannot be reached. Disabled days cannot be focused.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker: a disabled day button gets the disabled attribute
behaviors.note: The inventory says a disabled day stays focusable. In this library it leaves the tab order, so screen reader users do not discover it.

behaviors.text: Two or more months can show side by side, and paging can move one or all months.
behaviors.note: Outside days across a shared edge in a multi month view are unchecked.

behaviors.text: Today is marked, and the week starts on the locale's first day. Six rows can be kept for a steady height.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker: data-today, weekStartsOn, locale and fixedWeeks props
behaviors.note: The library marks today with data-today only. vois-calendar adds aria-current date to that day.

behaviors.text: Dates follow a chosen time zone.
behaviors.note: Dates are Date objects, not ISO strings. Convert at the edge of your form.

behaviors.text: The grid has a label, and each day has the full date as its name. Selected days are announced as selected.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker: role grid with aria-labelledby; day button aria-label is the full date; gridcell has aria-selected

behaviors.text: The month and year are announced when they change.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker: the caption is a span with role status and aria-live polite
behaviors.note: It is not a heading, so screen reader users cannot jump to it with heading keys.

behaviors.text: Previous and Next have clear names.
behaviors.evidence: react-day-picker: the previous button label defaults to Go to the Previous Month
behaviors.note: Set labelPrevious and labelNext to match your copy.

behaviors.text: Each target is large enough to press.
behaviors.evidence: registry/vois/calendar/calendar.tsx: day buttons use the --cal-cell size, 44 square on a coarse pointer and the minimum hit area otherwise
behaviors.note: The library has no size rule. The Vois item sets it.

mistakes.text: Do not sort out dates with strings. DayPicker uses Date objects, and a time zone shift can move a day.
mistakes.evidence: react-day-picker: selected and onSelect use Date

mistakes.text: Do not rely on disabled days to explain why they are off. Say why in text near the calendar.
mistakes.evidence: react-day-picker: a disabled day button is not focusable
mistakes.note: Screen reader users cannot reach it to read a reason.

mistakes.text: Do not shrink the day buttons under the minimum hit area to fit a small space. Let the calendar scroll or use a drawer.
